modern: The soul keeps its spherical form when it is neither stretched out towards any object, nor drawn in on itself, nor scattered, nor sinking down, but is lit by a light by which it sees the truth—the truth of all things and the truth that is in itself.
original: The spherical form of the soul maintains its figure when it is neither extended towards any object, nor contracted inwards, nor dispersed, nor sinks down, but is illuminated by light, by which it sees the truth,—the truth of all things and the truth that is in itself.
